name: Ryley
source:
Ryley... Admiral of the Guardians of Elysium and leader of the Valkyries, a small, elite branch of the Guardians that defend Elysium. She's also my instructor... yay, me. Though in fairness, she's been labeled as "Champion of Elysium" after the Great War where she, the Valkyries, and my father all were able to defeat the Abyssal Queen, Zenera. Although it seems, to me anyway, that she doesn't care much for the title. Just knowing that she was able to stop evil was all in a day's work for her. Which strikes me as odd that she wants to personally oversee my training as opposed to anyone else training... I mean, she instructs the Valkyries to oversee the training of other potential Guardians... but... to [i]personally[/i] oversee mine? I'm beyond honored... even if I technically outrank her.

[In game description]
